source: Scottish Government LiDAR Phase I 1 m DTM, 16 m nearest-pixel lattice, 0.1 m quantisation. Physical relative terrain; no railway warp. Datum is sampled station-origin ground plus 0.2 m, not a surveyed rail-head level.

provenance.method: Local x east/z south equirectangular frame; WGS84 treated as ETRS89 then OSTN15 to OSGB36/BNG. Each lattice node samples its containing native DTM pixel. Model y=AOD-referenceGroundAod-0.2. A node on a nodata pixel (a pond's water surface and isolated Phase I gaps) takes the LOWEST valid native pixel on the nearest of the rings 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128 m round it (16 bearings each) that has one: ASSUMED, the bank's lowest ground standing for the water surface; beyond 128 m the build refuses.
provenance.limitations: 16 m point sampling does not resolve track beds, retaining walls, bridge decks or narrow cuttings; 0.1 m quantisation is not source accuracy. Official DTM contains elevated surfaces/interpolation near the station (independently verified with Pillow/libtiff); it is not a rail profile. DTM beneath the station roof is processed/interpolated bare-earth, not independently surveyed rail height. No source vertical RMSE is asserted. Rails drawn at y=0 need a separate consistent scene ground treatment. Outside the extent the existing terrain API returns flat groundY.
